mapper.select: SELECT #{date} AS date, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM doctor_schedule_slot WHERE schedule_date = #{date} AND status = 'OPEN' ) AS schedule_slot_count, ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_capacity), 0) FROM doctor_schedule_slot WHERE schedule_date = #{date} AND status = 'OPEN' ) AS total_capacity, ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(remaining_capacity), 0) FROM doctor_schedule_slot WHERE schedule_date = #{date} AND status = 'OPEN' ) AS remaining_capacity, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM appointment WHERE schedule_date = #{date} AND status IN ('BOOKED', 'COMPLETED') ) AS active_appointment_count, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM appointment_waitlist waitlist INNER JOIN doctor_schedule_slot slot ON slot.id = waitlist.schedule_slot_id WHERE slot.schedule_date = #{date} AND waitlist.status = 'WAITING' ) AS waiting_count, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM appointment_waitlist WHERE status = 'OFFERED' AND offer_expire_time <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ) AS overdue_offered_count
